## What happened

Describe the expected result and actual result.

## Steps to reproduce

Provide the smallest task and steps that reproduce the problem.
Remove private task text and credentials.

## Environment

State the Model Pilot version, BB version, operating system, classifier provider, classifier model, and selected coding model.

## Evidence

Attach a redacted screenshot or error if useful.
Never attach API keys, account tokens, private session files, or confidential conversations.
Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md instead.
